title: A new tier appears in every matrix as Uses previous tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A with two ranges.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Type a name no other tier uses.
  4. Press Enter.
  5. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  6. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  7. Point at a cell in the new tier's column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the active tiers.

Step 2:

  • The new tier's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • The tier is created.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 6:

  • Matrix A's grid has a column for the new tier, last, headed by its number and name.
  • Both its cells read "Uses previous tier".

Step 7:

  • The hover names the tier before it by number and name, for example "Uses previous tier, 6 · Internal."
